**Finding: deviation (GOVLAW)**

The agreement's only governing-law provision sits at the tail of § 7 (numbered § 11, "SEVERABILITY; GOVERNING LAW", p0043) and selects **Arizona** law with no stated venue. Arizona is outside the accepted list, so the clause fails the fallback on a material term.

Redline (validated, preferred position): Arizona → **State of New York**, plus exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in **New York County**, with the severability sentence and conflict-of-laws carve-out left untouched.

On the related arbitration clause (p0056): it mandates binding arbitration under U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules with confirmation in U.S. courts. That is not a foreign-seated arbitration, so it is not walk-away territory and I did not disturb it; the new venue language is framed as applying to proceedings not resolved by arbitration to avoid an internal conflict.
